# ExternalValidation

This document merges every source file of the ExternalValidation folder. The prioritized
targets are re-tested in external molecular QTL resources (eQTLGen whole blood,
BrainMeta, Banner Health brain/plasma proteomics and Iceland plasma proteomics) with
two independent sleep apnea phenotypes (FinnGen R12 sleep apnea and the OSA MVP).

The "MR" scripts prepare the instruments, harmonise the exposure and outcome data and
run the two-sample MR analysis; the "RadialMR" scripts re-run the same variants with
radial MR to detect outliers, and the MR-PRESSO scripts summarise the MR-PRESSO
outlier and distortion tests.

## Notes on the merged code

* Each section below holds one source file of this folder, and the file name is given
  both in the section heading and in the first comment line of the chunk.
* Every path that pointed at the analysis tree of the original workstation is rewritten
  to a short relative path below the placeholder root `Path/`; `Path/datasource/` stands
  for the input data, `Path/R-4.3.1/bin/` for the R interpreter and
  `Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/` for the SMR executable. Point them at your own
  installation before running the code.
* The Chinese comments and chunk titles of the original scripts are given in English;
  the date of the original document header is not part of this merged file.
* Shell scripts are kept in their own `bash` chunks.

---

## `External_OSA_MR-PRESSO_res.Rmd`

```{r "External_OSA_MR-PRESSO_res.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: External_OSA_MR-PRESSO_res.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(MRPRESSO)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: unnamed chunk
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/")

res_bind<-data.frame(gene=NA,MRAnalysis=NA,OR=NA,nsnp=NA,Pvalue=NA,PvalueGlobalTest=NA)

for (gene in c("ABO","ARNTL","ATP6V1E1","CYP2T2P","DCXR","FEZ2","GPD2","L3MBTL2","MAP7D1","MCM6","MMAB","MRPL45P2","MVK","RALGAPA1","SSH2","TMEM106B")) {
  
  load(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/eQTLGen/harmonise_data/",gene,"_SleepApnea_har.RData",sep = ""))
  
  exp_out_har<-subset(exp_out_har,exp_out_har$mr_keep==TRUE)
  
  res<-mr_presso(BetaOutcome = "beta.outcome", BetaExposure = "beta.exposure", SdOutcome = "se.outcome", SdExposure = "se.exposure", OUTLIERtest = TRUE, DISTORTIONtest = TRUE, data = exp_out_har, NbDistribution = 1000,  SignifThreshold = 0.05)
  
  res_temp<-res$`Main MR results`
  res_temp$gene<-gene
  res_temp[1,"PvalueGlobalTest"]<-res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Global Test`$Pvalue
  res_temp[1,"nsnp"]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
  if(!is.null(res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`)){
    res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`$Pvalue<-as.numeric(res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`$Pvalue)
    res_temp[2,"nsnp"]<-nrow(subset(res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`,Pvalue>0.05))
  }
  res_temp$OR<-paste(round(exp(res_temp$`Causal Estimate`),3)," (",round(exp(res_temp$`Causal Estimate`-1.96*res_temp$Sd),3),"-",round(exp(res_temp$`Causal Estimate`+1.96*res_temp$Sd),3),")",sep = "")
  setnames(res_temp,c("MR Analysis","P-value"),c("MRAnalysis","Pvalue"))
  res_temp<-res_temp[,c("gene","MRAnalysis","OR","nsnp","Pvalue","PvalueGlobalTest")]
  
  res_bind<-rbind(res_bind,res_temp)

}

for (gene in c("CTD-2623N2.11","ECE2","FEZ2","GRPEL2","L3MBTL2")) {
  
  load(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/BrainMeta/harmonise_data/",gene,"_SleepApnea_har.RData",sep = ""))
  
  exp_out_har<-subset(exp_out_har,exp_out_har$mr_keep==TRUE)
  
  res<-mr_presso(BetaOutcome = "beta.outcome", BetaExposure = "beta.exposure", SdOutcome = "se.outcome", SdExposure = "se.exposure", OUTLIERtest = TRUE, DISTORTIONtest = TRUE, data = exp_out_har, NbDistribution = 1000,  SignifThreshold = 0.05)
  
  res_temp<-res$`Main MR results`
  res_temp$gene<-gene
  res_temp[1,"PvalueGlobalTest"]<-res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Global Test`$Pvalue
  res_temp[1,"nsnp"]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
  if(!is.null(res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`)){
    res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`$Pvalue<-as.numeric(res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`$Pvalue)
    res_temp[2,"nsnp"]<-nrow(subset(res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`,Pvalue>0.05))
  }
  res_temp$OR<-paste(round(exp(res_temp$`Causal Estimate`),3)," (",round(exp(res_temp$`Causal Estimate`-1.96*res_temp$Sd),3),"-",round(exp(res_temp$`Causal Estimate`+1.96*res_temp$Sd),3),")",sep = "")
  setnames(res_temp,c("MR Analysis","P-value"),c("MRAnalysis","Pvalue"))
  res_temp<-res_temp[,c("gene","MRAnalysis","OR","nsnp","Pvalue","PvalueGlobalTest")]
  
  res_bind<-rbind(res_bind,res_temp)
  
}

for (gene in c("LCT","PCSK1")) {
  
  load(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/Iceland/harmonise_data/",gene,"_SleepApnea_pQTL_har.RData",sep = ""))
  
  exp_out_har<-subset(exp_out_har,exp_out_har$mr_keep==TRUE)
  
  res<-mr_presso(BetaOutcome = "beta.outcome", BetaExposure = "beta.exposure", SdOutcome = "se.outcome", SdExposure = "se.exposure", OUTLIERtest = TRUE, DISTORTIONtest = TRUE, data = exp_out_har, NbDistribution = 1000,  SignifThreshold = 0.05)
  
  res_temp<-res$`Main MR results`
  res_temp$gene<-gene
  res_temp[1,"PvalueGlobalTest"]<-res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Global Test`$Pvalue
  res_temp[1,"nsnp"]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
  if(!is.null(res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`)){
    res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`$Pvalue<-as.numeric(res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`$Pvalue)
    res_temp[2,"nsnp"]<-nrow(subset(res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Outlier Test`,Pvalue>0.05))
  }
  res_temp$OR<-paste(round(exp(res_temp$`Causal Estimate`),3)," (",round(exp(res_temp$`Causal Estimate`-1.96*res_temp$Sd),3),"-",round(exp(res_temp$`Causal Estimate`+1.96*res_temp$Sd),3),")",sep = "")
  setnames(res_temp,c("MR Analysis","P-value"),c("MRAnalysis","Pvalue"))
  res_temp<-res_temp[,c("gene","MRAnalysis","OR","nsnp","Pvalue","PvalueGlobalTest")]
  
  res_bind<-rbind(res_bind,res_temp)
  
}

res_bind<-res_bind[-1,]
write.xlsx(res_bind,"External_OSA_MR-PRESSO_res.xlsx")
```

## `Banner_protein_OSAMVP_MR.Rmd`

```{r "Banner_protein_OSAMVP_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: Banner_protein_OSAMVP_MR.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(plinkbinr)
library(ieugwasr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mr.raps)
library(MRPRESSO)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/Banner/")

target<-c("TMEM106B","IFIT2","BCL2L13")

load("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/OSA_MVP_allSNP_hg19.RData")

dat_allSNP_hg19<- subset(dat_allSNP_hg19, dat_allSNP_hg19$FREQ<1)
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[order(dat_allSNP_hg19$P,decreasing = FALSE),]
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[!duplicated(dat_allSNP_hg19$SNP),]

row_file<-data.frame(protein=NA,nsnp=NA,sleep=NA,merge=NA,format_row=NA,clump_row=NA,harmonise_row=NA)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: harmonise
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/Banner/")
r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  protein<-read.csv(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/BannerBBDP/",
                          target[i],".csv",sep = ""))

  setnames(protein,c("POS","ALT","REF","BETA","P"),c("BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","Beta","Pval"))

  protein<-subset(protein,protein$Pval<5e-8)
  if(nrow(protein)==0)
    next
  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["protein"]][r] <- as.character(target[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(protein)
  row_file[["sleep"]][r] <- "OSAMVP"
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(protein,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".pr",".sl"))
  flip_pro <- rename(protein,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$Beta = 0-protein$Beta
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".pr",".sl"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  row_file[["merge"]][r] <- nrow(input)
  
  #format
  protein_format<-format_data(input,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "FREQ",
                          pval_col = "Pval",samplesize_col = "N")
  protein_format$exposure<-as.character(target[i])
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(protein_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-protein_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_OSAMVP_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 500,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.1,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_OSAMVP_clump)
  clump <- subset(protein_format, SNP %in% pro_OSAMVP_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(input,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "FREQ")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-"OSAMVP"
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 1) #the frequency column is missing
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/Banner/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target[i]),"_OSAMVP_har.RData",sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/Banner/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target[i]),"_OSAMVP_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

#save file
write.xlsx(row_file,"Banner_PlasmaPro_OSAMVP_row.xlsx")
rm(list = ls())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: MR
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/Banner/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,globaltest_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)

target<-c("TMEM106B","IFIT2","BCL2L13")

for (i in 1:length(target)) {

  if(file.exists(paste("harmonise_data/",
                       target[i],"_OSAMVP_har.RData",sep = ""))){
    folder_path<-paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",sep = "")
    dir.create(folder_path)

    load(paste("harmonise_data/",target[i],"_OSAMVP_har.RData",sep = ""))
    
    if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har,mr_keep==TRUE))!=0){
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,            b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,globaltest_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,
                                         id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)
      
      if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har,mr_keep==TRUE))>2){
        exp_out_har_mrdeft<-mr(exp_out_har,method_list=                               
                              c("mr_ivw","mr_egger_regression","mr_weighted_median"))
        exp_out_har_mrhet<-mr_heterogeneity(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrplt<-mr_pleiotropy_test(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrsin<-mr_singlesnp(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrloo<-mr_leaveoneout(exp_out_har)

       #plots
       exp_out_har_scatP<-mr_scatter_plot(exp_out_har_mrdeft,exp_out_har)
       exp_out_har_scatP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_scatP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",target[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_har_scatP.pdf",sep = "")))

       exp_out_har_sinP<-mr_forest_plot(exp_out_har_mrsin)
       exp_out_har_sinP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_sinP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",target[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_har_sinP.pdf",sep = "")))

       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrsubres,file =

       #add mr.raps for weak instrumental
       exp_out_har_mrraps<-mr.raps(b_exp = exp_out_har$beta.exposure,

       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrraps,file=

                                "_OSAMVP_har_mr_rapsres.csv",sep = "")))

       ##transform list to data.frame
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re<-as.data.frame(exp_out_har_mrraps)

       ##rename colnames to merge
       setnames(exp_out_har_mrraps_re,c("beta.hat","beta.se","beta.p.value"),

        paste(target[i],"OSAMVP","har",sep = "_"))
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re<-exp_out_har_mrraps_re[,c("Method","outcome","exposure",                       "nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept",
      "intercept_se","intercept_pval","globaltest_pval","id.outcome",
      "id.exposure","exp_out_har_pair")]

       write.csv(exp_out_har_mr_bindres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",
                                target[i],"_OSAMVP_har_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
      }
      all_res<-rbind(all_res,exp_out_har_mr_bindres)
      
    }else{
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,            b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,globaltest_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,

}
```

```{r "Banner_protein_sleepapnea_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
target<-c("Q9NUM4","P09913","Q9BXK5")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/Banner/")

target<-c("TMEM106B","IFIT2","BCL2L13")

load("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/sleepapnoea_FINNGEN_R12_allSNP_hg19.RData")

dat_allSNP_hg19<- subset(dat_allSNP_hg19, dat_allSNP_hg19$FREQ<1)
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[order(dat_allSNP_hg19$P,decreasing = FALSE),]
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[!duplicated(dat_allSNP_hg19$SNP),]

row_file<-data.frame(protein=NA,nsnp=NA,sleep=NA,merge=NA,format_row=NA,clump_row=NA,harmonise_row=NA)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: harmonise
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/Banner/")
r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  protein<-read.csv(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/BannerBBDP/",
                          target[i],".csv",sep = ""))

  setnames(protein,c("POS","ALT","REF","BETA","P"),c("BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","Beta","Pval"))

  protein<-subset(protein,protein$Pval<5e-8)
  if(nrow(protein)==0)
    next
  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["protein"]][r] <- as.character(target[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(protein)
  row_file[["sleep"]][r] <- "SleepApnea"
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(protein,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".pr",".sl"))
  flip_pro <- rename(protein,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$Beta = 0-protein$Beta
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".pr",".sl"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  row_file[["merge"]][r] <- nrow(input)
  
  #format
  protein_format<-format_data(input,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "FREQ",
                          pval_col = "Pval",samplesize_col = "N")
  protein_format$exposure<-as.character(target[i])
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(protein_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-protein_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_SleepApnea_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 500,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.1,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  clump <- subset(protein_format, SNP %in% pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(input,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "FREQ")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-"SleepApnea"
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 1) #the frequency column is missing
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/Banner/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target[i]),"_SleepApnea_har.RData",sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/Banner/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target[i]),"_SleepApnea_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

#save file
write.xlsx(row_file,"Banner_PlasmaPro_SleepApnea_row.xlsx")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: MR
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/Banner/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)

                                "_SleepApnea_har_funnelP.pdf",sep = "")))

       #combine_all_mrresults 
       exp_out_har_mrallres<-combine_all_mrresults(res = exp_out_har_mrdeft,

                                           plt =exp_out_har_mrplt,
```

```{r "BrainMeta_gene_OSAMVP_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup

library(dplyr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/BrainMeta/")

target<-c("ENSG00000171055.15","ENSG00000145194.19","ENSG00000164284.15","ENSG00000141458.13","ENSG00000267289.1","ENSG00000015475.19","ENSG00000100395.15")
target_name<-c("FEZ2","ECE2","GRPEL2","NPC1","CTD-2623N2.11","BID","L3MBTL2")

load("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/OSA_MVP_allSNP_hg19.RData")

dat_allSNP_hg19<- subset(dat_allSNP_hg19, dat_allSNP_hg19$FREQ<1)
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[order(dat_allSNP_hg19$P,decreasing = FALSE),]
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[!duplicated(dat_allSNP_hg19$SNP),]

row_file<-data.frame(gene=NA,nsnp=NA,sleep=NA,merge=NA,format_row=NA,clump_row=NA,harmonise_row=NA)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: harmonise
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/BrainMeta/")
r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  gene<-read.table(paste("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/BrainMeta_cis_eqtl_summary/brain_",target[i],".txt",sep = ""),header = T,sep = "\t")

  setnames(gene,c("Chr","A1","A2","b"),c("CHR","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","Beta"))

  gene<-subset(gene,gene$p<5e-8)
  if(nrow(gene)==0)
    next
  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["gene"]][r] <- as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(gene)
  row_file[["sleep"]][r] <- "OSAMVP"
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(gene,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".ge",".sl"))
  flip_pro <- rename(gene,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$Beta = 0-gene$Beta
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".ge",".sl"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  row_file[["merge"]][r] <- nrow(input)
  
  #format
  gene_format<-format_data(input,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP.ge",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "Freq",
                          pval_col = "p")
  gene_format$exposure<-as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(gene_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-gene_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_OSAMVP_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 500,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.1,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_OSAMVP_clump)
  clump <- subset(gene_format, SNP %in% pro_OSAMVP_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(input,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP.sl",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "FREQ")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-"OSAMVP"
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 2) 
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/BrainMeta/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_OSAMVP_har.RData",
                         sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/BrainMeta/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_OSAMVP_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

#save file
write.xlsx(row_file,"BrainMeta_BloodGene_OSAMVP_row.xlsx")

rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/BrainMeta/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

       ##transform list to data.frame

       ##rename colnames to merge

       exp_out_har_mrraps_re<-exp_out_har_mrraps_re[,c("Method","outcome","exposure",                       "nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept",

                        SignifThreshold = 0.05)
  
         res_temp<-res$`Main MR results`
         res_temp$Method<-res_temp$`MR Analysis`

         res_temp$Q<-"NA"
         res_temp$Q_df<-"NA"
         res_temp$Q_pval<-"NA"
         res_temp$intercept<-"NA"
         res_temp$intercept_se<-"NA"

         exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-rbind(exp_out_har_mr_bindres,res_temp)
       }

                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target_name[i],"_OSAMVP/",target_name[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_har_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
```

```{r "BrainMeta_gene_OSAMVP_RadialMR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res$OR<-paste(round(exp(all_res$b),3)," (",round(exp(all_res$b-1.96*all_res$se),3),"-",round(exp(all_res$b+1.96*all_res$se),3),")",sep = "")

write.csv(all_res,file = file.path("BrainMeta_BrainGene_OSAMVP_Radialmr_bindres.csv"))
write.xlsx(all_res,file = file.path("BrainMeta_BrainGene_OSAMVP_Radialmr_bindres.xlsx"))
```

## `BrainMeta_gene_sleepapnea_MR.Rmd`

```{r "BrainMeta_gene_sleepapnea_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: BrainMeta_gene_sleepapnea_MR.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(plinkbinr)
library(ieugwasr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mr.raps)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/BrainMeta/")

target<-c("ENSG00000171055.15","ENSG00000145194.19","ENSG00000164284.15","ENSG00000141458.13","ENSG00000267289.1","ENSG00000015475.19","ENSG00000100395.15")
target_name<-c("FEZ2","ECE2","GRPEL2","NPC1","CTD-2623N2.11","BID","L3MBTL2")

load("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/sleepapnoea_FINNGEN_R12_allSNP_hg19.RData")

dat_allSNP_hg19<- subset(dat_allSNP_hg19, dat_allSNP_hg19$FREQ<1)
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[order(dat_allSNP_hg19$P,decreasing = FALSE),]
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[!duplicated(dat_allSNP_hg19$SNP),]

row_file<-data.frame(gene=NA,nsnp=NA,sleep=NA,merge=NA,format_row=NA,clump_row=NA,harmonise_row=NA)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: harmonise
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/BrainMeta/")
r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  gene<-read.table(paste("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/BrainMeta_cis_eqtl_summary/brain_",target[i],".txt",sep = ""),header = T,sep = "\t")

  setnames(gene,c("Chr","A1","A2","b"),c("CHR","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","Beta"))

  gene<-subset(gene,gene$p<5e-8)
  if(nrow(gene)==0)
    next
  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["gene"]][r] <- as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(gene)
  row_file[["sleep"]][r] <- "SleepApnea"
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(gene,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".ge",".sl"))
  flip_pro <- rename(gene,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$Beta = 0-gene$Beta
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".ge",".sl"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  row_file[["merge"]][r] <- nrow(input)
  
  #format
  gene_format<-format_data(input,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP.ge",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "Freq",
                          pval_col = "p")
  gene_format$exposure<-as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(gene_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-gene_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_SleepApnea_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 500,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.1,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  clump <- subset(gene_format, SNP %in% pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(input,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP.sl",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "FREQ")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-"SleepApnea"
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 2) 
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/BrainMeta/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_SleepApnea_har.RData",
                         sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/BrainMeta/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_SleepApnea_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

#save file
write.xlsx(row_file,"BrainMeta_BloodGene_SleepApnea_row.xlsx")
rm(list = ls())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: MR
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/BrainMeta/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)

       #combine_all_mrresults 
       exp_out_har_mrallres<-combine_all_mrresults(res = exp_out_har_mrdeft,

                                "_SleepApnea_har_mr_allres.csv",sep = "")))

       ##subset for rbind

       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrsubres,file =

                                "_SleepApnea_har_mr_subres.csv",sep = "")))

       #add mr.raps for weak instrumental

       ##transform list to data.frame
```

```{r "BrainMeta_gene_sleepapnea_RadialMR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}
```

```{r "eQTLGen_gene_OSAMVP_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[!duplicated(dat_allSNP_hg19$SNP),]

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/eQTLGen/")
r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  gene<-read.table(paste("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/eQTLGen/blood_",
                          target[i],".txt",sep = ""),header = T,sep = "\t")

  setnames(gene,c("Chr","A1","A2","b"),c("CHR","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","Beta"))

  gene<-subset(gene,gene$p<5e-8)
  if(nrow(gene)==0)
    next
  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["gene"]][r] <- as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(gene)
  row_file[["sleep"]][r] <- "OSAMVP"
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(gene,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".ge",".sl"))
  flip_pro <- rename(gene,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$Beta = 0-gene$Beta
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".ge",".sl"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  row_file[["merge"]][r] <- nrow(input)
  
  #format
  gene_format<-format_data(input,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP.ge",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "Freq",
                          pval_col = "p")
  gene_format$exposure<-as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(gene_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-gene_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_OSAMVP_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 500,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.1,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_OSAMVP_clump)
  clump <- subset(gene_format, SNP %in% pro_OSAMVP_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(input,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP.sl",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "FREQ")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-"OSAMVP"
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 2) 
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/eQTLGen/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_OSAMVP_har.RData",
                         sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/eQTLGen/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_OSAMVP_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: MR
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/eQTLGen/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,globaltest_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)

target_name<-c("MAP7D1","FEZ2","MCM6","GPD2","TMEM106B","ABO","ARNTL","MMAB","MVK","RALGAPA1","SSH2","MRPL45P2","DCXR","CYP2T2P","ATP6V1E1","L3MBTL2")
```

```{r "eQTLGen_gene_OSAMVP_RadialMR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)
library(mr.raps)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: MR
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/eQTLGen/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}
```

```{r "eQTLGen_gene_sleepapnea_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/eQTLGen/")

target<-c("ENSG00000116871","ENSG00000171055","ENSG00000076003","ENSG00000115159","ENSG00000106460","ENSG00000175164","ENSG00000133794","ENSG00000139428","ENSG00000110921","ENSG00000174373","ENSG00000141298","ENSG00000228782","ENSG00000169738","ENSG00000233622","ENSG00000131100","ENSG00000100395")
target_name<-c("MAP7D1","FEZ2","MCM6","GPD2","TMEM106B","ABO","ARNTL","MMAB","MVK","RALGAPA1","SSH2","MRPL45P2","DCXR","CYP2T2P","ATP6V1E1","L3MBTL2")

load("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/sleepapnoea_FINNGEN_R12_allSNP_hg19.RData")

dat_allSNP_hg19<- subset(dat_allSNP_hg19, dat_allSNP_hg19$FREQ<1)
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[order(dat_allSNP_hg19$P,decreasing = FALSE),]
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[!duplicated(dat_allSNP_hg19$SNP),]

row_file<-data.frame(gene=NA,nsnp=NA,sleep=NA,merge=NA,format_row=NA,clump_row=NA,harmonise_row=NA)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: harmonise
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/eQTLGen/")
r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  gene<-read.table(paste("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/eQTLGen/blood_",
                          target[i],".txt",sep = ""),header = T,sep = "\t")

  setnames(gene,c("Chr","A1","A2","b"),c("CHR","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","Beta"))

  gene<-subset(gene,gene$p<5e-8)
  if(nrow(gene)==0)
    next
  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["gene"]][r] <- as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(gene)
  row_file[["sleep"]][r] <- "SleepApnea"
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(gene,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".ge",".sl"))
  flip_pro <- rename(gene,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$Beta = 0-gene$Beta
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,dat_allSNP_hg19,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".ge",".sl"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  row_file[["merge"]][r] <- nrow(input)
  
  #format
  gene_format<-format_data(input,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP.ge",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "Freq",
                          pval_col = "p")
  gene_format$exposure<-as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(gene_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-gene_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_SleepApnea_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 500,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.1,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  clump <- subset(gene_format, SNP %in% pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(input,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP.sl",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "FREQ")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-"SleepApnea"
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 2) 
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/eQTLGen/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_SleepApnea_har.RData",
                         sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/eQTLGen/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_SleepApnea_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

#save file

rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/eQTLGen/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}
```

```{r "eQTLGen_gene_sleepapnea_RadialMR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: eQTLGen_gene_sleepapnea_RadialMR.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(data.table)

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}
```
