## `Iceland_pQTL_OSAMVP_MR.Rmd`

```{r "Iceland_pQTL_OSAMVP_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: Iceland_pQTL_OSAMVP_MR.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(plinkbinr)
library(ieugwasr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mr.raps)
library(MRPRESSO)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/Iceland/")

target<-c("LCT","PCSK1","CALCOCO2")
target_chr<-c("2","5","17")
target_tssbp<-c("136594750","95768984","46908396")

load("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/OSA_MVP_allSNP_hg19.RData")
dat_allSNP_hg19<- subset(dat_allSNP_hg19, dat_allSNP_hg19$FREQ<1)
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[order(dat_allSNP_hg19$P,decreasing = FALSE),]
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[!duplicated(dat_allSNP_hg19$SNP),]

row_file<-data.frame(protein=NA,nsnp=NA,sleep=NA,merge=NA,format_row=NA,clump_row=NA,harmonise_row=NA)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: harmonise
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sleep_dat<-dat_allSNP_hg19
rm(dat_allSNP_hg19)
setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/Iceland/")
r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  load(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/Iceland/",target[i],
             "_allSNP_hg19.RData",sep = ""))
  protein<-dat_allSNP_hg19
  rm(dat_allSNP_hg19)
  setnames(protein,c("Chrom","Pos","effectAllele","otherAllele","rsids"),c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","SNP"))
  
  protein<-subset(protein,protein$Pval<5e-8)
  
  protein$CHR<-as.character(protein$CHR)
  protein$CHR<- sapply(protein$CHR,function(x){
				temp <- strsplit(x ,"chr")[[1]][2]
				return(as.integer(temp))	
				})
  
  protein<-subset(protein,protein$CHR==as.integer(target_chr[i]))
  protein<-subset(protein,protein$BP>as.integer(target_tssbp[i])-500000 
                  & protein$BP<as.integer(target_tssbp[i])+500000)
  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["protein"]][r] <- as.character(target[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(protein)
  row_file[["sleep"]][r] <- "OSAMVP"
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(protein,sleep_dat,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".pr",".sl"))
  flip_pro <- rename(protein,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$Beta = 0-protein$Beta
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,sleep_dat,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".pr",".sl"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  row_file[["merge"]][r] <- nrow(input)
  
  #format
  protein_format<-format_data(input,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP.pr",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "FREQ",
                          pval_col = "Pval",samplesize_col = "N")
  protein_format$exposure<-as.character(target[i])
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(protein_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-protein_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_OSAMVP_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 500,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.1,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_OSAMVP_clump)
  clump <- subset(protein_format, SNP %in% pro_OSAMVP_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(input,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP.sl",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "FREQ")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-"OSAMVP"
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 1) #the frequency column is missing
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/Iceland/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target[i]),"_OSAMVP_pQTL_har.RData",sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/Iceland/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target[i]),"_OSAMVP_pQTL_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

#save file
write.xlsx(row_file,"Iceland_PlasmaProQTL_OSAMVP_row.xlsx")
rm(list = ls())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: MR
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/Iceland/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,globaltest_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)

target<-c("LCT","PCSK1","CALCOCO2")

for (i in 1:length(target)) {

  if(file.exists(paste("harmonise_data/",
                       target[i],"_OSAMVP_pQTL_har.RData",sep = ""))){
    folder_path<-paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",sep = "")
    dir.create(folder_path)

    load(paste("harmonise_data/",target[i],"_OSAMVP_pQTL_har.RData",sep = ""))
    exp_out_har<-subset(exp_out_har,exp_out_har$mr_keep==TRUE)
    
    if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har,mr_keep==TRUE))!=0){
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,            b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,globaltest_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,
                                         id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)
      
      if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har,mr_keep==TRUE))>2){
        exp_out_har_mrdeft<-mr(exp_out_har,method_list=                               
                              c("mr_ivw","mr_egger_regression","mr_weighted_median"))
        exp_out_har_mrhet<-mr_heterogeneity(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrplt<-mr_pleiotropy_test(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrsin<-mr_singlesnp(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrloo<-mr_leaveoneout(exp_out_har)

       #plots
       exp_out_har_scatP<-mr_scatter_plot(exp_out_har_mrdeft,exp_out_har)
       exp_out_har_scatP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_scatP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",target[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_scatP.pdf",sep = "")))

       exp_out_har_sinP<-mr_forest_plot(exp_out_har_mrsin)
       exp_out_har_sinP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_sinP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",target[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_sinP.pdf",sep = "")))

       exp_out_har_looP<-mr_leaveoneout_plot(exp_out_har_mrloo)
       exp_out_har_looP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_looP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",target[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_looP.pdf",sep = "")))

       exp_out_har_funnelP<-mr_funnel_plot(exp_out_har_mrsin)
       exp_out_har_funnelP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_funnelP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",target[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_funnelP.pdf",sep = "")))

       #combine_all_mrresults 
       exp_out_har_mrallres<-combine_all_mrresults(res = exp_out_har_mrdeft, 
                                           het= exp_out_har_mrhet,
                                           plt =exp_out_har_mrplt,
                                           sin = exp_out_har_mrsin, 
                                           ao_slc = FALSE)
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrallres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",target[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_mr_allres.csv",sep = "")))

       ##subset for rbind
       exp_out_har_mrsubres<-exp_out_har_mrallres[-which(exp_out_har_mrallres$Method==
                                                          "Wald ratio"),]
       exp_out_har_mrsubres<-exp_out_har_mrsubres[,c("Method","outcome","exposure","nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept","intercept_se","intercept_pval","id.outcome","id.exposure")]
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrsubres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",target[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_mr_subres.csv",sep = "")))

       #add mr.raps for weak instrumental
       exp_out_har_mrraps<-mr.raps(b_exp = exp_out_har$beta.exposure,
                                 b_out = exp_out_har$beta.outcome,
                                 se_exp = exp_out_har$se.exposure,
                                 se_out = exp_out_har$se.outcome)
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrraps,file= 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",target[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_mr_rapsres.csv",sep = "")))

       ##transform list to data.frame
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re<-as.data.frame(exp_out_har_mrraps)

       ##rename colnames to merge
       setnames(exp_out_har_mrraps_re,c("beta.hat","beta.se","beta.p.value"),
             c("b","se","pval"))
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Method<-"MR RAPS"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$outcome<-"OSAMVP"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$exposure<-as.character(target[i])
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$nsnp<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"nsnp"]
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Q<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Q_df<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Q_pval<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$intercept<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$intercept_se<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$intercept_pval<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$id.outcome<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$id.exposure<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re<-exp_out_har_mrraps_re[,c("Method","outcome","exposure",                       "nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept",
                                                       "intercept_se","intercept_pval",
                                                       "id.outcome","id.exposure")]

       #rbind mr results
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-rbind(exp_out_har_mrsubres,exp_out_har_mrraps_re)
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres$exp_out_har_pair=as.character(paste(target[i],                                                           "OSAMVP","har",sep = "_"))
       
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres$globaltest_pval<-NA
       
       if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har,mr_keep==TRUE))>3){
  
         res<-mr_presso(BetaOutcome = "beta.outcome", BetaExposure = "beta.exposure", 
                        SdOutcome = "se.outcome", SdExposure = "se.exposure", 
                        OUTLIERtest = TRUE, DISTORTIONtest = TRUE, 
                        data = exp_out_har, NbDistribution = 1000,  
                        SignifThreshold = 0.05)
  
         res_temp<-res$`Main MR results`
         res_temp$Method<-res_temp$`MR Analysis`
         res_temp$outcome<-"OSAMVP"
         res_temp$exposure<-as.character(target[i])
         res_temp$nsnp<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"nsnp"]
         res_temp$b<-res_temp$`Causal Estimate`
         res_temp$se<-res_temp$Sd
         res_temp$pval<-res_temp$`P-value`
         res_temp$Q<-"NA"
         res_temp$Q_df<-"NA"
         res_temp$Q_pval<-"NA"
         res_temp$intercept<-"NA"
         res_temp$intercept_se<-"NA"
         res_temp$intercept_pval<-"NA"
         res_temp$id.outcome<-"NA"
         res_temp$id.exposure<-"NA"
         res_temp$exp_out_har_pair<-as.character(paste(target[i],
                                                       "OSAMVP","har",sep = "_"))
         res_temp[1,"globaltest_pval"]<-res$`MR-PRESSO results`$`Global Test`$Pvalue

         res_temp<-res_temp[,c("Method","outcome","exposure",                   "nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept","intercept_se","intercept_pval","globaltest_pval","id.outcome","id.exposure","exp_out_har_pair")]
  
         exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-rbind(exp_out_har_mr_bindres,res_temp)
       }
       
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mr_bindres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",target[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
      }else{
       exp_out_har_mrdeft<-mr(exp_out_har)
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"Method"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"method"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"outcome"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"outcome"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"exposure"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"exposure"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"nsnp"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"nsnp"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"b"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"b"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"se"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"se"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"pval"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"pval"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"id.outcome"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"id.outcome"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"id.exposure"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"id.exposure"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"exp_out_har_pair"]=as.character(
        paste(target[i],"OSAMVP","har",sep = "_"))
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mr_bindres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_OSAMVP/",
                                target[i],"_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
      }
      all_res<-rbind(all_res,exp_out_har_mr_bindres)
      
    }else{
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,            b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,globaltest_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,
                                         id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"Method"]<-"None"
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"outcome"]<-"OSAMVP"
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"exposure"]<-target[i]
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"nsnp"]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
      all_res<-rbind(all_res,exp_out_har_mr_bindres)
    }
  }
}

#save all_res
all_res<-all_res[-1,]
all_res$Q_pval<-as.double(all_res$Q_pval)
all_res$Q<-as.double(all_res$Q)
all_res$Q_df<-as.double(all_res$Q_df)
all_res$intercept_pval<-as.double(all_res$intercept_pval)
all_res$intercept<-as.double(all_res$intercept)
all_res$intercept_se<-as.double(all_res$intercept_se)

all_res$OR<-paste(round(exp(all_res$b),3)," (",round(exp(all_res$b-1.96*all_res$se),3),"-",round(exp(all_res$b+1.96*all_res$se),3),")",sep = "")

write.csv(all_res,file = file.path("Iceland_PlasmaProQTL_OSAMVP_mr_bindres.csv"))
write.xlsx(all_res,file = file.path("Iceland_PlasmaProQTL_OSAMVP_mr_bindres.xlsx"))
```

```{r "Iceland_pQTL_OSAMVP_RadialMR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
for (i in 1:length(target_name)) {

  if(file.exists(paste("harmonise_data/",
                       target_name[i],"_OSAMVP_pQTL_har.RData",sep = ""))){

    ivw_radial <- RadialMR::ivw_radial(

    weights = 1
    )

    r_input = exp_out_har,
    alpha = 0.05,
    weights = 1
    )

    if (
    is.character(ivw_radial[["outliers"]]) &
      is.data.frame(egger_radial[["outliers"]])
    ) {
    outliers <- c(egger_radial[["outliers"]][["SNP"]])
    exp_out_har <- exp_out_har[which(!exp_out_har$SNP %in% outliers), ]
    }

    if (
    is.data.frame(ivw_radial[["outliers"]]) &
      is.character(egger_radial[["outliers"]])
    ) {
    outliers <- c(ivw_radial[["outliers"]][["SNP"]])
    exp_out_har <- exp_out_har[which(!exp_out_har$SNP %in% outliers), ]
    }

    if (
    is.data.frame(ivw_radial[["outliers"]]) &
      is.data.frame(egger_radial[["outliers"]])
    ) {
    outliers <- c(
      ivw_radial[["outliers"]][["SNP"]],
      egger_radial[["outliers"]][["SNP"]]
    )
    outliers <- outliers[which(duplicated(outliers) == F)]
    exp_out_har <- exp_out_har[which(!exp_out_har$SNP %in% outliers), ]
    }
    exp_out_har<-subset(exp_out_har,!is.na(beta.exposure))
    exp_out_har<-subset(exp_out_har,!is.na(beta.outcome))
    exp_out_har<-subset(exp_out_har,!is.na(se.exposure))
    exp_out_har<-subset(exp_out_har,!is.na(se.outcome))
    
    
    #MR
    if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har,mr_keep==TRUE))!=0){
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,            b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)
      
      if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har,mr_keep==TRUE))>2){
        exp_out_har_mrdeft<-mr(exp_out_har,method_list=                               
                              c("mr_ivw","mr_egger_regression","mr_weighted_median"))
        exp_out_har_mrhet<-mr_heterogeneity(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrplt<-mr_pleiotropy_test(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrsin<-mr_singlesnp(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrloo<-mr_leaveoneout(exp_out_har)

       #plots
       exp_out_har_scatP<-mr_scatter_plot(exp_out_har_mrdeft,exp_out_har)
       exp_out_har_scatP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_scatP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",target_name[i],"_OSAMVP/",target_name[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_Radial_scatP.pdf",sep = "")))

       exp_out_har_sinP<-mr_forest_plot(exp_out_har_mrsin)
       exp_out_har_sinP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_sinP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",target_name[i],"_OSAMVP/",target_name[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_Radial_sinP.pdf",sep = "")))

       exp_out_har_looP<-mr_leaveoneout_plot(exp_out_har_mrloo)
       exp_out_har_looP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_looP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",target_name[i],"_OSAMVP/",target_name[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_Radial_looP.pdf",sep = "")))

       exp_out_har_funnelP<-mr_funnel_plot(exp_out_har_mrsin)
       exp_out_har_funnelP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_funnelP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",target_name[i],"_OSAMVP/",target_name[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_Radial_funnelP.pdf",sep = "")))

       #combine_all_mrresults 
       exp_out_har_mrallres<-combine_all_mrresults(res = exp_out_har_mrdeft, 
                                           het= exp_out_har_mrhet,
                                           plt =exp_out_har_mrplt,

       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrallres,file =

                                                          "Wald ratio"),]

       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrsubres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target_name[i],"_OSAMVP/",target_name[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_Radial_mr_subres.csv",sep = "")))

       #add mr.raps for weak instrumental
       exp_out_har_mrraps<-mr.raps(b_exp = exp_out_har$beta.exposure,
                                 b_out = exp_out_har$beta.outcome,
                                 se_exp = exp_out_har$se.exposure,
                                 se_out = exp_out_har$se.outcome)
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrraps,file=

      }else{

       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"exp_out_har_pair"]=as.character(
        paste(target_name[i],"OSAMVP","har",sep = "_"))
       
       #add mr.raps for weak instrumental
       exp_out_har_mrraps<-mr.raps(b_exp = exp_out_har$beta.exposure,
                                 b_out = exp_out_har$beta.outcome,
                                 se_exp = exp_out_har$se.exposure,

       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrraps,file= 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target_name[i],"_OSAMVP/",target_name[i],
                                "_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_Radial_mr_rapsres.csv",sep = "")))

       ##transform list to data.frame
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re<-as.data.frame(exp_out_har_mrraps)

       ##rename colnames to merge
       setnames(exp_out_har_mrraps_re,c("beta.hat","beta.se","beta.p.value"),
             c("b","se","pval"))
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Method<-"MR RAPS"

       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$exposure<-as.character(target_name[i])
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$nsnp<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"nsnp"]
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Q<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Q_df<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Q_pval<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$intercept<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$intercept_se<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$intercept_pval<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$id.outcome<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"id.outcome"]
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$id.exposure<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"id.exposure"]
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$exp_out_har_pair=as.character(
        paste(target_name[i],"OSAMVP","har",sep = "_"))
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re<-exp_out_har_mrraps_re[,c("Method","outcome","exposure",                       "nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept",
      "intercept_se","intercept_pval","id.outcome","id.exposure","exp_out_har_pair")]

       #rbind mr results
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-rbind(exp_out_har_mr_bindres,exp_out_har_mrraps_re)
       
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mr_bindres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target_name[i],"_OSAMVP/",
                                target_name[i],"_OSAMVP_pQTL_har_Radial_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
      }
      all_res<-rbind(all_res,exp_out_har_mr_bindres)
      
    }else{
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,            b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)

}
```

```{r "Iceland_pQTL_sleepapnea_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
target_chr<-c("2","5","17")
target_tssbp<-c("136594750","95768984","46908396")

load("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/sleepapnoea_FINNGEN_R12_allSNP_hg19.RData")
dat_allSNP_hg19<- subset(dat_allSNP_hg19, dat_allSNP_hg19$FREQ<1)
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[order(dat_allSNP_hg19$P,decreasing = FALSE),]
dat_allSNP_hg19<- dat_allSNP_hg19[!duplicated(dat_allSNP_hg19$SNP),]

row_file<-data.frame(protein=NA,nsnp=NA,sleep=NA,merge=NA,format_row=NA,clump_row=NA,harmonise_row=NA)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: harmonise
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sleep_dat<-dat_allSNP_hg19
rm(dat_allSNP_hg19)
setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/Iceland/")
r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  load(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/Iceland/",target[i],
             "_allSNP_hg19.RData",sep = ""))
  protein<-dat_allSNP_hg19
  rm(dat_allSNP_hg19)
  setnames(protein,c("Chrom","Pos","effectAllele","otherAllele","rsids"),c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","SNP"))
  
  protein<-subset(protein,protein$Pval<5e-8)
  
  protein$CHR<-as.character(protein$CHR)
  protein$CHR<- sapply(protein$CHR,function(x){
				temp <- strsplit(x ,"chr")[[1]][2]
				return(as.integer(temp))	
				})
  
  protein<-subset(protein,protein$CHR==as.integer(target_chr[i]))
  protein<-subset(protein,protein$BP>as.integer(target_tssbp[i])-500000 
                  & protein$BP<as.integer(target_tssbp[i])+500000)
  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["protein"]][r] <- as.character(target[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(protein)
  row_file[["sleep"]][r] <- "SleepApnea"
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(protein,sleep_dat,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".pr",".sl"))
  flip_pro <- rename(protein,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$Beta = 0-protein$Beta
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,sleep_dat,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".pr",".sl"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  row_file[["merge"]][r] <- nrow(input)
  
  #format
  protein_format<-format_data(input,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP.pr",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "FREQ",
                          pval_col = "Pval",samplesize_col = "N")
  protein_format$exposure<-as.character(target[i])
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(protein_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-protein_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_SleepApnea_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 500,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.1,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  clump <- subset(protein_format, SNP %in% pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(input,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP.sl",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "FREQ")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-"SleepApnea"
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 1) #the frequency column is missing
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/Iceland/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target[i]),"_SleepApnea_pQTL_har.RData",sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/ExternalValidation/Iceland/harmonise_data/",
                         as.character(target[i]),"_SleepApnea_pQTL_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

#save file

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/ExternalValidation/Iceland/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

       exp_out_har_funnelP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_funnelP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_SleepApnea/",target[i],
                                "_SleepApnea_pQTL_har_funnelP.pdf",sep = "")))

       #combine_all_mrresults 
       exp_out_har_mrallres<-combine_all_mrresults(res = exp_out_har_mrdeft, 
                                           het= exp_out_har_mrhet,
                                           plt =exp_out_har_mrplt,
                                           sin = exp_out_har_mrsin, 
                                           ao_slc = FALSE)
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrallres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_SleepApnea/",target[i],
                                "_SleepApnea_pQTL_har_mr_allres.csv",sep = "")))

       ##subset for rbind
       exp_out_har_mrsubres<-exp_out_har_mrallres[-which(exp_out_har_mrallres$Method==
                                                          "Wald ratio"),]
       exp_out_har_mrsubres<-exp_out_har_mrsubres[,c("Method","outcome","exposure","nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept","intercept_se","intercept_pval","id.outcome","id.exposure")]
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrsubres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_SleepApnea/",target[i],
                                "_SleepApnea_pQTL_har_mr_subres.csv",sep = "")))

       #add mr.raps for weak instrumental
       exp_out_har_mrraps<-mr.raps(b_exp = exp_out_har$beta.exposure,
                                 b_out = exp_out_har$beta.outcome,
                                 se_exp = exp_out_har$se.exposure,
                                 se_out = exp_out_har$se.outcome)
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrraps,file= 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_SleepApnea/",target[i],
                                "_SleepApnea_pQTL_har_mr_rapsres.csv",sep = "")))

       ##transform list to data.frame
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re<-as.data.frame(exp_out_har_mrraps)

       ##rename colnames to merge
       setnames(exp_out_har_mrraps_re,c("beta.hat","beta.se","beta.p.value"),
             c("b","se","pval"))
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Method<-"MR RAPS"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$outcome<-"SleepApnea"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$exposure<-as.character(target[i])
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$nsnp<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"nsnp"]
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Q<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Q_df<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Q_pval<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$intercept<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$intercept_se<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$intercept_pval<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$id.outcome<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$id.exposure<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re<-exp_out_har_mrraps_re[,c("Method","outcome","exposure",                       "nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept",
                                                       "intercept_se","intercept_pval",
                                                       "id.outcome","id.exposure")]

       #rbind mr results
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-rbind(exp_out_har_mrsubres,exp_out_har_mrraps_re)
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres$exp_out_har_pair=as.character(paste(target[i],                                                           "SleepApnea","har",sep = "_"))
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mr_bindres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_SleepApnea/",target[i],
                                "_SleepApnea_pQTL_har_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
      }else{
       exp_out_har_mrdeft<-mr(exp_out_har)
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"Method"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"method"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"outcome"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"outcome"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"exposure"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"exposure"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"nsnp"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"nsnp"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"b"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"b"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"se"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"se"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"pval"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"pval"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"id.outcome"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"id.outcome"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"id.exposure"]<-exp_out_har_mrdeft[1,"id.exposure"]
       exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"exp_out_har_pair"]=as.character(
        paste(target[i],"SleepApnea","har",sep = "_"))
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mr_bindres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",target[i],"_SleepApnea/",
                                target[i],"_SleepApnea_pQTL_har_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
      }
      all_res<-rbind(all_res,exp_out_har_mr_bindres)
      
    }else{
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,            b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"Method"]<-"None"
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"outcome"]<-"SleepApnea"
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"exposure"]<-target[i]
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"nsnp"]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
      all_res<-rbind(all_res,exp_out_har_mr_bindres)
    }
  }
}

#save all_res
all_res<-all_res[-1,]
all_res$Q_pval<-as.double(all_res$Q_pval)
all_res$Q<-as.double(all_res$Q)
all_res$Q_df<-as.double(all_res$Q_df)
all_res$intercept_pval<-as.double(all_res$intercept_pval)
all_res$intercept<-as.double(all_res$intercept)
all_res$intercept_se<-as.double(all_res$intercept_se)

all_res$OR<-paste(round(exp(all_res$b),3)," (",round(exp(all_res$b-1.96*all_res$se),3),"-",round(exp(all_res$b+1.96*all_res$se),3),")",sep = "")

write.csv(all_res,file = file.path("Iceland_PlasmaProQTL_SleepApnea_mr_bindres.csv"))
write.xlsx(all_res,file = file.path("Iceland_PlasmaProQTL_SleepApnea_mr_bindres.xlsx"))
```
